summary: Implemented SHACL path support in rdflib/paths.py via build_shacl_path(graph, node), which returns a URIRef for plain predicates or a Path (InvPath, AlternativePath, MulPath, SequencePath) for complex SHACL paths, raising ValueError for invalid input. Added 35 tests in test/test_path.py. test/test_path.py plus the rdflib/paths.py doctests pass (38 passed) using the shared venv. Black and mypy are not installed in that venv, so formatting and type checks were not run; long lines were wrapped by hand. rdflib/paths.py changed on disk mid-session; I re-read it and the tests still pass. Nothing was committed.
